verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public marketing pricing page with per-hour GPU prices (e.g., B300 at $8.99/hr) and REST, GraphQL, CLI and MCP interfaces for managing Pods, endpoints, templates and volumes. None of the evidence documents an endpoint an agent can query for the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability. A static pricing web page and resource-management APIs are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
